use enaho01a-2025-500.dta, clear
rename *, lower
keep if (p204 == 1 | missing(p204)) & p208a >= 14 & fac500a > 0 & !missing(fac500a)
merge 1:1 conglome vivienda hogar codperso using enaho01a-2025-400.dta, keepusing(p4191 p4192 p4193 p4194) keep(master match) nogenerate

gen ocupado = ocu500 == 1
* Observatory rule, used from 2024 on. Up to 2023: gen informal = ocupinf == 1 if ocupado
gen sin_ruc = p510a1 == 3
gen seguro_trabajo = p4191 == 1 | p4192 == 1 | p4193 == 1 | p4194 == 1
gen desprotegido = (!seguro_trabajo & p558a5 == 5) | inlist(p511a, 5, 7)

egen estrato_dept = group(dept estrato)

# Empleo formal, ENAHO 2025. Observatorio Laboral del Perú.
library(haven); library(dplyr); library(survey)
ruta <- "."  # folder with the ENAHO 2025 .dta files
leer <- function(f) read_dta(file.path(ruta, f)) |> zap_labels() |> rename_with(tolower)
among <- function(x, m) ifelse(m %in% 1, as.integer(coalesce(as.logical(x), FALSE)), NA_integer_)

d <- leer("enaho01a-2025-500.dta") |> filter(p204 %in% 1 | is.na(p204), p208a >= 14, fac500a > 0)
d <- left_join(d, leer("enaho01a-2025-400.dta") |> select(conglome, vivienda, hogar, codperso, p4191, p4192, p4193, p4194), by = c("conglome", "vivienda", "hogar", "codperso"))

d <- d |> mutate(
  ocupado = as.integer(ocu500 %in% 1),
  # Observatory rule, used from 2024 on. Up to 2023: informal = among(ocupinf %in% 1, ocupado)
  sin_ruc = p510a1 %in% 3,
  seguro_trabajo = p4191 %in% 1 | p4192 %in% 1 | p4193 %in% 1 | p4194 %in% 1,
  desprotegido = (!seguro_trabajo & p558a5 %in% 5) | p511a %in% c(5, 7),
  informal = case_when(ocupado != 1 ~ NA_integer_, p507 %in% 1:2 ~ as.integer(sin_ruc), p507 %in% c(3, 4, 6, 7) ~ as.integer(sin_ruc | desprotegido), p507 %in% 5 ~ 1L),
  formal = 1L - informal
)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")  # singleton strata centred on the grand mean
d <- d |> mutate(estrato_dept = paste(substr(ubigeo, 1, 2), estrato))
des <- svydesign(ids = ~conglome, strata = ~estrato_dept, weights = ~fac500a, data = d, nest = TRUE)

r <- svymean(~formal, subset(des, ocupado %in% 1), na.rm = TRUE)
est <- 100 * unname(coef(r))
cat("Empleo formal, 2025:", round(est, 2), "  error estándar:", round(100 * unname(SE(r)), 3), "\n")

# Empleo formal, ENAHO 2025. Observatorio Laboral del Perú.
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

RUTA = "."  # folder with the ENAHO 2025 .dta files
CLAVES = ['conglome', 'vivienda', 'hogar', 'codperso']


def leer(archivo, columnas=None):
    t = pd.read_stata(f"{RUTA}/{archivo}", convert_categoricals=False, columns=columnas)
    t.columns = t.columns.str.lower()
    return t


def among(x, m):
    """x as 0/1 where m equals 1, missing elsewhere."""
    return x.astype(float).where(m.eq(1))


def se_total(z):
    """Taylor standard error of a total of scores z: PSUs within strata, singleton strata centred."""
    p = pd.DataFrame({"h": d.estrato_dept, "c": d.conglome, "z": z}).groupby(["h", "c"]).z.sum().reset_index()
    n = p.groupby("h").z.transform("size")
    dev = p.z - p.groupby("h").z.transform("mean")
    v = (n / (n - 1) * dev ** 2)[n > 1].sum() + ((p.z[n == 1] - p.z.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    return v ** 0.5


def ratio(y, m):
    """Weighted mean of y where m is true, with its design standard error."""
    m = m & y.notna()
    w = d.fac500a.where(m, 0)
    r = (w * y.fillna(0)).sum() / w.sum()
    return r, se_total(w * (y.fillna(0) - r) / w.sum())


d = leer("enaho01a-2025-500.dta")
d = d[d.p204.fillna(1).eq(1) & (d.p208a >= 14) & (d.fac500a > 0)].reset_index(drop=True)
d = d.merge(leer("enaho01a-2025-400.dta", CLAVES + ['p4191', 'p4192', 'p4193', 'p4194']), on=CLAVES, how="left")
d["estrato_dept"] = d.ubigeo.str[:2] + "-" + d.estrato.astype(int).astype(str)

d["ocupado"] = d.ocu500.eq(1).astype(int)
# Observatory rule, used from 2024 on. Up to 2023: informal = among(d.ocupinf.eq(1), d.ocupado)
sin_ruc = d.p510a1.eq(3)
seguro_trabajo = d.p4191.eq(1) | d.p4192.eq(1) | d.p4193.eq(1) | d.p4194.eq(1)
desprotegido = (~seguro_trabajo & d.p558a5.eq(5)) | d.p511a.isin([5, 7])
occ = d.ocupado.eq(1)
d["informal"] = np.nan
d.loc[occ & d.p507.isin([1, 2]), "informal"] = sin_ruc.astype(float)
d.loc[occ & d.p507.isin([3, 4, 6, 7]), "informal"] = (sin_ruc | desprotegido).astype(float)
d.loc[occ & d.p507.eq(5), "informal"] = 1.0
d["formal"] = 1 - d.informal

est, se = ratio(d.formal, d.ocupado.eq(1))
est, se = 100 * est, 100 * se
print(f"Empleo formal, 2025: {est:.1f}%   error estándar: {se:.2f}")
